note: HCPARAM-ALL: the parameters a hardened core was built with, keyed by die + module + signed-record sha (records: INDEX.tsv record/db sha256 or PROVENANCE routed_db_sha256). A view dir that is swapped or copied still resolves by module (+ record sha when several parameter sets exist). Harvested entries: signed kit config.mk VERILOG_TOP_PARAMS (empty = built with the module defaults); every signed kit of the module agreed on one parameter set. An unlisted signed core is a HARD_CORE_PARAM_ALL error unless hard_core_param_allow.json lists it.
